chunks: O you who believe, save yourselves and your families from the Fire whose fuel is men and rocks, over which are appointed angels stern and severe as wardens who never disobey what God commands them, and do what they are commanded;
ai.seo_question: How do I protect my family from the Hellfire according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the primary religious duty of the head of the household to guide family members through both outward instruction and inward spiritual cultivation, reflecting the Imams' role as protectors of the community. The mention of 'fuel' being people and stones is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring to the disbelievers and their idols, underscoring the tangible consequences of spiritual negligence. This directive serves as a foundational principle for familial accountability in Shia jurisprudence, linking individual piety to collective salvation.
